narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Twelve and twenty six are safe, because the two numbers are far apart.
<bookmark mark='two'/>Let Jumpy hop with a jump size of two and watch where he lands.
<bookmark mark='both'/>He lands on twelve after six hops, and he lands on twenty six after thirteen hops.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Two divides both numbers exactly, so Jumpy reaches both treasures.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says 12 and 26 are safe; Jumpy hops in jumps of 2 and lands on 12 and on 26; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>To hide treasures from Jumpy, choose two numbers whose only common factor is one.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. Which pair can Grumpy use to hide the treasures, six and nine, or five and eight?
